_about: Public-domain John Colet (1467-1519, Dean of St Paul's) in English for the Word Hoard: J. H. Lupton's editions with translation of the Two Treatises on the Hierarchies of Dionysius (1869), the Exposition of Romans (1873), the Exposition of 1 Corinthians (1874) and the Letters to Radulphus (1876), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 31 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

colet-hierarchies-dionysius: Two Treatises on the Hierarchies of Dionysius, with a translation by J. H. Lupton (London: Bell and Daldy, 1869)
colet-exposition-romans: An Exposition of St. Paul's Epistle to the Romans, with a translation by J. H. Lupton (London: Bell and Daldy, 1873)
colet-exposition-1-corinthians: An Exposition of St. Paul's First Epistle to the Corinthians, with a translation by J. H. Lupton (London: George Bell and Sons, 1874)
colet-letters-radulphus: Letters to Radulphus on the Mosaic Account of the Creation, with Other Treatises, with a translation by J. H. Lupton (London: George Bell and Sons, 1876)

_alternates.colet-copies: Other copies of the Dionysius and Radulphus volumes

_excluded.colet-sacraments: Lupton's 1867 Treatise on the Sacraments: Latin text only, no translation
_excluded.colet-lives: Lupton's and Knight's Lives of Colet; Seebohm's Oxford Reformers
